caption:
Your database is a revenue channel.

Most shops only use it once, at the sale.

Here's the framework: the Retention Triangle.

01. Reviews. Every completed job triggers the same automated ask. New leads see proof before they call.

02. Reactivation. Customers quiet for 6 to 12 months get an automated check-in. No manual list-pulling.

03. Referral. Every 5-star review or finished job fires a trackable referral link. You see exactly who sent it and what it closed.

Same customers. Three separate revenue events. None of it needs new ad spend.

See all three running on your own numbers. 14 days free.
DM TRIAL

rationale: Carousels lead 2026 saves/depth for B2B authority content, and this ships an unclaimed retention framework (reviews, reactivation, referral as three separate revenue events) distinct from every prior stage, ladder, ownership, aging-bucket, matrix, segmentation, cadence, and budget-allocation model already covered.
